description: Same digital-arrest script in romanised Marathi (Marathlish): atket, gothavla, sangu naka, tabadtob, paise pathva. English 'transfer' and 'paise bhejo' are deliberately not used.

events.text: Mi CBI adhikari boltoy. Tumhi atket ahat. Tumcha khata gothavla jaeel. Konala hi sangu naka. Tabadtob paise pathva.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Call cut karu naka. He digital atak ahe, gunha dakhal zala. Otp sanga.
events.speaker: caller

events.text: Verification sathi rakam pathva. Paise pathava, aata.
events.speaker: caller
